title: Beyond the Omega
description: With the Proof of Everything, the Omnilex Engine can be pushed past the possible - into the Transcendental.

puzzle.goal: Everything, in one line. Write the single action density from which every law you have met follows: the curvature of spacetime and the energy of its vacuum; the three gauge forces; matter fields moving through them; a field filling space whose potential has its minimum away from zero, and the couplings through which matter feels it; a dark scalar that only gravity sees; the pressure of hot matter in chemical equilibrium (temperature times entropy, plus every species' chemical potential times its number density, minus the energy density); and the thermodynamic price of every bit of information erased.
puzzle.name: The Omnilex Lagrangian - the Standard Model with gravity, the dark sector, thermodynamics, chemistry and information

puzzle.ask: The scalar's potential is smallest where φ†φ = v²/2; small ripples about that minimum are a particle of mass m = √(2λ)·v. With the measured self-coupling and vacuum value given, find that mass in GeV.

vars.R: Ricci scalar - the curvature of spacetime
vars.\u039b: cosmological constant - the energy of the vacuum
vars.F: gauge field strength of the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces
vars.v: vacuum expectation value of the scalar
vars.y: Yukawa coupling matrix (sets every matter particle's mass)
vars.\u03c1I: density of erased information (bits per volume per time)

puzzle.method: Assemble it sector by sector: curvature over 16πG; −¼ of the squared field strength; the Dirac kinetic term; the covariant kinetic term and quartic potential of the scalar; the Yukawa couplings plus their conjugate; a free massive scalar; the fluid pressure from Euler's relation p = Ts + Σμn − u; and a Landauer term kT ln 2 per erased bit.
